---
title: "Directory"
description: "Search graduate students and alumni of UGA's School of Public & International Affairs by research area, method, region, and more."
---

```{r}
source("R/site.R")
library(jsonlite)

# Only public, already-cleaned fields go into the page.
dir_data <- people |>
  transmute(
    id, first = first_name, last = last_name, pronouns,
    photo = photo_url, program, status, cohort = cohort_year,
    subfields, interests, methods, regions,
    blurb, dissertation = dissertation_title,
    grad_year, current = paste(coalesce(current_title, ""), coalesce(current_org, ""), sep = ", ") |>
      stringr::str_remove("^, |, $") |> na_if("") |> na_if(", "),
    open_coauthoring, open_reading_drafts, open_mock_job_talks,
    open_mentoring, open_coffee_chats
  )

vocab_terms <- function(f) readr::read_csv(paste0("data/vocab/", f, ".csv"),
                                           show_col_types = FALSE)$term
statuses <- c(vocab_terms("status"), if (build_mode == "test") "Faculty (test data)")
options_json <- list(
  program  = vocab_terms("program"),
  status   = statuses,
  subfield = vocab_terms("subfields"),
  method   = vocab_terms("methods"),
  region   = vocab_terms("regions"),
  cohort   = sort(unique(na.omit(people$cohort_year)), decreasing = TRUE),
  open     = open_to_vocab
)
json <- toJSON(list(people = dir_data, options = options_json),
               auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null", null = "null")
json <- gsub("</", "<\\/", json, fixed = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| output: asis
cat(raw_block(tagList(
  test_banner(build_mode),
  breadcrumbs(list(text = "Home", href = "index.html"), list(text = "Directory")),
  h1(class = "page-title", "Graduate Student Directory")
)))
```

::: {.lead-red}
Find SPIA graduate students and alumni by what they study, how they study it, and what they are open to helping with.
:::
